capabilities: Create daily notes automatically on vault startup
Backfill daily notes for days the vault was not opened
Fill missing daily notes for an arbitrary past date range via a command
Reuse the settings and templates configured in the daily notes core plugin
extras: Known issues: misbehaves when daily notes use a folder structure (e.g. YYYY/MM/DD) or have extra text in the filename, due to limitations in the obsidian-daily-notes-interface package; asks for confirmation when backfilling more than a week of missed notes.
intentEvidence: designed to be an add-on to the daily notes core plugin, rather than a replacement
problem: The daily notes core plugin only creates a note when you open it, so days you did not open the vault get no note, and the built-in startup option forces the daily note open.

relations.evidence: It acts as an alternative to Auto Journal.
caused by the underlying obsidian-daily-notes-interface package

summary: Add-on to the daily notes core plugin that automatically creates missing daily notes on startup or on demand for past date ranges.
